title: Chargaff's Rules
text: Erwin Chargaff discovered that in any DNA molecule, the amount of adenine equals the amount of thymine (A=T), and the amount of guanine equals the amount of cytosine (G=C).

title: Complementary Base Pairing
text: In DNA, adenine (A) always pairs with thymine (T) through two hydrogen bonds. This means if you know the percentage of A, you automatically know the percentage of T - they are equal.

title: Calculate Thymine
text: Since A = T (Chargaff's rule), and adenine is 22%, what is the percentage of thymine?
